verdict.rationale: PostHog is a SaaS analytics platform, so the official MCP server axis applies. It ships a free, hosted, official MCP server at mcp.posthog.com/mcp, documented in depth: client compatibility, install command, a 953-tool inventory, CLI mode, per-session tool scoping and Streamable HTTP transport. An independent live probe confirms an OAuth-gated remote MCP endpoint with granular scopes.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: It works with any MCP-compatible client, including PostHog Desktop, Claude Code, Claude Desktop, Cursor, Codex, VS Code, Windsurf, and Zed.
The PostHog MCP server exposes function-calling MCP tools across every PostHog product – from feature flags and experiments to error tracking, logs, surveys, and SQL.
a live, OAuth-gated remote MCP server per the MCP authorization spec, with per-resource read/write scopes.
